label: good
why: Claim facts only: NDVI threshold pre-segmentation of plant vs soil; no invented histogram wording required.
claims: 1. A computer-implemented method for the optimized segmentation and/or classification of a plant object on underlying soil, the method comprising: providing at least one image scene which includes at least one plant object and an underlying soil; pre-segmenting the image scene using an initially predetermined, dynamically variable NDVI threshold in order to identify and remove the at least one plant object from the image scene based on an NDVI index; calculating a multiplicity of NDVI indices of the underlying soil remaining in the image scene after pre-segmentation; determining at least one mean value of the multiplicity of NDVI indices of the underlying soil for the image scene; caching or storing the at least one mean value in a mean value history; determining the median value based on the history; dynamic updating of the mean value history; and segmenting and/or classifying the at least one plant object using the dynamically changing median value as the NDVI threshold.
definition: Methods or arrangements for recognising patterns involving the quantisation of grey-tone or colour values, e.g. converting a continuous grey-tone image into a two-tone image, or converting a continuous colour image into a limited number of colours.
sentence: The method pre-segments an image scene with a dynamically variable NDVI threshold to separate a plant object from underlying soil, then updates a median NDVI threshold from soil NDVI history for further segmentation or classification.

label: good
why: Supported claim facts: x-ray imaging of flowing particles; identify by boundaries/shapes/density.
claims:
1. A monitoring apparatus for an agricultural machine for handling flowable particulate materials, the apparatus comprising: an x-ray imaging device arranged to be supported on the agricultural machine in proximity to a flow of the particulate materials, the X-ray imaging device including an x-ray emitter and an x-ray detector for generating x-ray images of the particulate materials from the flow; and a controller arranged to process the x-ray images to identify interested particles comprising desirable particles or non-desirable particles within the particulate materials of the flow, calculate a numerical value representing an amount of the interested particles, and display the numerical value to an operator.
2. The apparatus according to claim 1 wherein the controller is arranged to identify the particles in the x-ray images using contrast changes to define object boundaries and comparing similarity between shapes of the object boundaries and predetermined particle shapes.
3. The apparatus according to claim 1 or claim 2 wherein the controller is arranged to identify the particles in the x-ray images by comparing density patterns in the x-ray images to predetermined density patterns.
definition: The investigation of free particles or cells, i.e. particles or cells that are able to freely move or removably sit on a surface for analytical purposes, or particles or cells which do not form part of a biological tissue.
sentence: The apparatus uses an x-ray imaging device on an agricultural machine to image a flow of particulate materials and a controller identifies desirable or non-desirable particles by object boundaries, shapes, and density patterns.

sentence: The claims describe processing medical images to determine patient-specific EAT or PCAT metrics together with vessel geometry, plaque characteristics, or hemodynamic measurements, then using those metrics for a risk score or disease-state classification.
